no_tempo_analyzer.title: AX BPM: no local tempo analyzer available
no_tempo_analyzer.description:
AX BPM is tracking {entry_title}. Deezer metadata covers most tracks, but tracks where Deezer reports bpm: 0 need local audio analysis. No audio decoder is available for the built-in NumPy tempo estimator, so those tracks will resolve to unknown.

To fix: install one of the supported decoders (miniaudio, soundfile, or an ffmpeg binary) in the Home Assistant environment, or install the AX BPM Analyzer add-on for aubio-grade accuracy.

user.title: AX BPM Configuration
user.description: Track the tempo (BPM) of the currently playing media. All network requests are anonymous — no API key required. {analyzer_status}

data_description.octave_disambiguation: Correct beat-tracker octave errors. 'Genre + mood' needs the AX BPM Analyzer add-on; it degrades to genre-only when the analyzer is unreachable.
data_description.analyzer_url: Leave empty to auto-detect the analyzer (Supervisor discovery, then homeassistant.local:8099). The analyzer provides aubio-grade tempo + mood analysis.
data_description.analyzer_api_token: Shared secret set in the AX BPM Analyzer add-on options. Sent as a Bearer token on /analyze only. Leave empty if the add-on has no token set.

halve_bpm.name: Halve BPM
halve_bpm.description: Halves the currently published BPM for the playing track and persists the correction. Use when the sensor reports double the real tempo (e.g. 150 instead of 75).

double_bpm.name: Double BPM
double_bpm.description: Doubles the currently published BPM for the playing track and persists the correction. Use when the sensor reports half the real tempo (e.g. 75 instead of 150).

clear_override.name: Clear BPM override
clear_override.description: Removes the manual halve/double override for the currently playing track, restoring automatic resolution.

clear_cache.name: Clear BPM cache
clear_cache.description: Wipes the persistent BPM cache. Manual overrides are not affected.

clear_overrides.name: Clear all BPM overrides
clear_overrides.description: Removes all manual halve/double overrides. The BPM cache is not affected.
